parameters.content:
## Trellis: Facebook Insights Sync

The Facebook half of the post-performance loop. Mirrors
`S2-instagram-insights-sync.json`, which now filters to `platform=eq.instagram`
so the two never collide.

Every 6 hours: read published **Facebook** rows from `scheduled_social_posts`
(last 30 days, `post_id` present) -> resolve that brand's Page token ->
`GET /{post_id}/insights` -> append a snapshot row to `social_post_insights`
with `platform='facebook'`.

### Setup after import
Confirm the `Sproutify Trellis` Supabase credential on the three HTTP nodes, then activate.

### Metric mapping (NOT the same as Instagram)
| Column | Facebook metric |
|---|---|
| impressions | post_impressions |
| reach | post_impressions_unique |
| likes | sum of post_reactions_by_type_total |
| saves / shares / comments | **NULL** - no equivalent in this metric set |

The full breakdown is kept in `raw`, which is what the Post Scheduler history
reads to show Impressions / Engaged / Clicks for Facebook rows.
Snapshots are append-only, so a post accumulates a time series.
